observations: A complete internal combustion engine with a black plastic casing.
Green spray paint is applied to the top surface of the casing.
The engine is resting on a concrete floor with a person's feet visible at the bottom.
The engine is shown from the top, showing the valve cover, wiring harness, and part of the intake manifold.
No brand name, model number, or part number is legible on the casing.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The engine may be a used or scrap unit rather than a new or high-mileage replacement.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine's identification plate (usually on the side or bottom).
risks.if_unproven: as a used engine with unknown condition

risks.risk: Internal mechanical damage or seized components.
risks.proof: A video of the engine being cranked or a compression test result.
A clear photo of the engine code stamped on the metal casing.
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest-value engine of this type

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine identification plate (usually stamped on the casing).
Video of the engine being cranked to check for smooth operation.
Photo of the engine code stamped on the metal casing.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
